issues.description: The ordering of parameters for teleport_s differs between the problem statement, the template, and the solution. The problem statement and tests expect teleport_s(circ, data_qubit, injection_qubit, p=0.0) (data_qubit first), while the template stub defines teleport_s(circ, injection_qubit, data_qubit, p=0.0) (injection_qubit first). The solution implements teleport_s(circ, data_qubit, injection_qubit, p=0.0). This inconsistency can confuse students about the correct parameter order and lead to signature/usage errors when following the exercise or running tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the teleport_s function signature across all artifacts. Prefer the signature used in the problem statement and solution: def teleport_s(circ: stim.Circuit, data_qubit: int, injection_qubit: int, p: float = 0.0) -> int. Update the template stub (msd.py) to match this ordering and ensure the docstring and any example usage reflect the same parameter order.
